contents.name: Host
contents.description: IP address or host name of the Modbus TCP device (e.g. "192.168.0.10" or "modbus-server").

contents.name: Port
contents.description: TCP port of the Modbus device (e.g. 502, the standard Modbus TCP port).

contents.name: UnitIdentifier
contents.description: Modbus unit identifier used to address the device (e.g. 255 for a directly addressed Modbus TCP server, or 1-247 when routing through a gateway to a serial slave).

contents.name: DefaultReadCycleInterval
contents.description: Default poll interval in seconds for streams that do not set their own ReadCycleInterval (e.g. 10).

contents.name: WriteCycleInterval
contents.description: The Modbus write cycle interval in seconds (e.g. 10) for writing values to the Modbus device with parameters.

contents.name: Streams
contents.description: Contains all Modbus streams of the given source.

contents.name: Parameter
contents.description: For writing configuration values to the Modbus device.

contents.name: Health
contents.description: Health message with Modbus source specific health information.
